text:
Anya (Partnerships): quick heads-up — we need a short contingency for the marketplace catalog soft-open. press embargo is tight, but hardware SI final cert might slip. want a standby path for landing + press hold?
Dylan (Marketing): +1. can we define a 'soft-open' landing that doesn't trigger press (no hero banner, no email)?
Carla (Product): should be simple — toggle live=false on the microsite and enable tenant onboarding without public CTA. that keeps flows for early partners.
Anya (Partnerships): exactly. proposal: 1) landing internal-only link for partners, 2) feature-flagged hero for full announce, 3) SI standby plan to flip once cert is green.
Ravi (SI Lead): we can have SI-specific onboarding URL. need a short runbook for handoff to SI ops. estimated 2-3 hours to wire for each tenant.
Sanjay (Platform): FYI infra wise we can route staging traffic via /si-onboard/* and keep CDN cache-control noindex. low effort. I can prod infra today.
Dylan (Marketing): draft of copy for soft-open? something neutral: "Partner portal: Early onboarding access" — avoids public language.
Michael (Legal): thumbs up on neutral copy. embargo-safe phrasing only. avoid product claims until embargo lifts.
Anya (Partnerships): ok putting this into a tiny checklist. tagging ops-bot to capture infra deploy and PRs.
ops-bot: deployment queued: staging -> si-onboard route; ETA 20m. link: https://deploys.redwood.example/1755
Carla (Product): minimal runbook snippet for SI handoff:
```
- Create tenant on staging
- Assign SI onboarding URL (/si-onboard/{tenant})
- Share ephemeral creds + checklist with Ravi
- Verify model routing and billing flags set to partner-tier
- Do quick smoke: generate chat -> verify latency < 600ms
```
Ravi (SI Lead): we'll prep SI ops with that. can we add a fallback: if cert fails at last minute -> redirect hero to "Request early access" form (no press).
Dylan (Marketing): good fallback — capture emails instead of press blast. use existing form: https://redwood.example/early-access
Anya (Partnerships): assigning owners: Sanjay = infra toggle, Ravi = SI handoff, Dylan = soft-copy + form, Michael = legal check, Carla = QA smoke. I'll be owner for final go/no-go. deadline EOD tomorrow.
Sanjay (Platform): noted. I'll post update when route is live.
ops-bot: route /si-onboard/* is now live on staging — deployment 1755 succeeded.
Anya (Partnerships): perfect. Ravi, can you run one tenant tonight and report smoke in this thread?
Ravi (SI Lead): yes — I'll onboard tenant alpha and post results by 22:00 PT.
Dylan (Marketing): prepping minimal partner-facing copy now, will drop drafts in #marketing-review.
Michael (Legal): I'll review copy by noon tomorrow.
Carla (Product): will run the latency + billing smoke after Ravi completes.
Anya (Partnerships): thanks team — feeling good about fallback path. any blockers?
Ravi (SI Lead): none for now. will update if cert or integration issues pop up.
Dylan (Marketing): no blockers. keeping press team on standby but not scheduled until we flip hero. :thumbsup:
Anya (Partnerships): excellent. closing checklist here, will reopen if anything changes.
